title: MEDA Filtering Package v1.0 Filtered Record
description: JSON Schema for one line of meda_filtered.jsonl. Derived from the Normalized Schema (v2.1): the canonical members sol, sclk_s, lmst, ltst, utc, measurements, quality and sources keep their names, types and meaning. Only accepted measurements are present. One additive member, filtering_metadata, is defined. A record with no accepted measurement is never written. The Normalized dataset is never modified.
$comment: Differences from the Normalized Schema, all deliberate: (1) measurements holds accepted measurements only (minProperties 1) and every one has validity 'valid'. (2) filtering_metadata is added. (3) raw_channels, raw_channel_issues, unmapped_channels and quarantined_channels are NOT carried over: they hold values that the filter never evaluates (raw ENG/RDS/ATS channels, sentinel-flagged raw values, quarantined channels), so copying them would put unevaluated data into an accepted-only dataset. (4) 'missing' and 'conflicts' are preserved verbatim as Normalizer context; they may name measurements that were withheld. Invariants not expressible in JSON Schema (filtering_metadata.measurements_accepted equals the number of keys in measurements, and evaluated = accepted + rejected + review_required) are checked by filtered_schema_validator.py.

sol.description: Mars Sol number, derived from the product file name.

sclk_s.description: Spacecraft Clock (SCLK) as a canonical decimal string. Never a JSON number. Format: no sign, no exponent, no leading zeros, no trailing fractional zeros. Example: '735849600' or '735849600.123'. Canonical rule: '100.0' and '100' both become '100'; '100.010' becomes '100.01'.

lmst.description: Local Mean Solar Time string, copied verbatim from the source CSV. Null when absent or empty in the source.

ltst.description: Local True Solar Time string, copied verbatim from the source CSV. Null when absent or empty in the source.

utc.description: UTC timestamp. Always null in Normalizer v2.1 output: UTC conversion requires SPICE SCLK+LSK kernels which are not available to the Normalizer.

measurements.description: Accepted measurements only, keyed by canonical name exactly as in the Normalized record. Measurements decided 'rejected' or 'review_required' are absent; their counts are in filtering_metadata and their decisions are in the Filtering Report.

quality.description: Quality / flag values of the Normalized record, copied unchanged (all keys, including flags of products whose measurements were withheld). No good/bad interpretation is applied by the filter.

sources.description: List of provenance dicts for every contributing source row (one per CSV row that shared this exact Sol+SCLK). Never empty in a valid record.

missing.description: Canonical measurement names that could not be built, with the reason. Reasons: 'empty_cell' (cell was None in source) or 'column_absent' (column not present in the CSV). Only contains measurements not present in the 'measurements' dict. Only present when at least one measurement was missing.

conflicts.description: List of conflict records where the same key appeared with differing content across contributing source rows. Kinds: 'duplicate_measurement', 'quality', 'time_metadata', 'raw_channels'. The first value encountered is kept in measurements/quality; the other is listed here. Only present when conflicts occurred.

accepted_measurement.description: An accepted measurement. Byte-for-byte the Normalized measurement object (same keys, same values) restricted to what a validity='valid' measurement carries: no raw_value and no validity_reason, because the Normalizer writes those only when validity is not 'valid'. The filter adds NO fields to measurement objects.

value.description: Numeric value copied unchanged from the Normalized measurement. Never null in the Filtered Dataset.

unit.description: Short unit symbol (e.g. 'Pa', 'K', 'm/s', 'W/m2', 'ppm', 'deg'). Null when the XML label states no unit and the unit is unverified (e.g. relative humidity channels). See also unit_verified.

source_unit.description: Unit string exactly as found in the PDS4 XML label (e.g. 'pascal', 'kelvin'). Null when the label states no unit.

unit_basis.description: Evidence basis for the unit. 'label' = unit verified against the XML label. 'bundle_description' = from bundle description (not used by v2.1). 'not_stated' = label has no <unit> element.

validity.description: Always 'valid' for an accepted measurement: FILT-001, FILT-002 and FILT-003 are mandatory core rules and every other validity value is rejected or sent to review.

source_level.description: Processing level of the source CSV. 'calibrated' or 'derived'.

source_file.description: Source CSV file name (without directory path).

source_row.description: Physical CSV line number (1-based, header = line 1). Null when line tracking is unavailable.

source_channel.description: Original CSV column name that produced this measurement (e.g. 'PRESSURE', 'HORIZONTAL_WIND_SPEED').

unit_verified.description: Present and false only when unit is null and unit_basis is 'not_stated'. Absent for measurements whose unit is verified from the label.

uncertainty.description: Copied unchanged from the Normalized measurement when present. Its own validity is NOT evaluated by the filter (see README known limitations); consumers must check uncertainty.validity.

allOf.description: normalize._build_measurement: unit_verified=false is written exactly when ChannelSpec.unit is None.

value.description: Numeric uncertainty value or null (null when validity is not 'valid').

unit.description: Unit symbol for the uncertainty value. May be null if the label states no unit.

source_channel.description: CSV column name containing the uncertainty value.

validity.description: Validity of the uncertainty value using the same vocabulary as measurement.validity.

raw_value.description: Original uncertainty value (number, or text when non_numeric). Present only when uncertainty validity is not 'valid'.

source_provenance.description: Provenance of one contributing CSV row.

release.description: Numeric release number extracted from the file name (e.g. 'P02' -> 2). Null when not determinable.

original_sclk.description: SCLK text exactly as found in the CSV, before canonical normalization.

source_archive.description: Source archive identifier. Present only when archive provenance is recorded.

conflict_record.description: One conflict entry. normalize.normalize_group writes 'key' for kinds duplicate_measurement / quality / raw_channels and 'field' (not 'key') for kind time_metadata. Remaining members (kept, other, other_source) vary by kind and are open.

key.description: Canonical measurement name, quality key, or '<PRODUCT>.<level>' key.

field.description: Time field name ('lmst' or 'ltst'); time_metadata conflicts only.

filtering_metadata.description: Record-level filtering summary. Counts describe the measurements of the source Normalized record that the filter evaluated.

ruleset_version.description: Version of the rule set (meda_filtering.rules.RULESET_VERSION) used for this run.
